children: Global Gp Llc, acting as an insider, purchased common units representing limited partner interests in two transactions on 2026-09-17 and 2026-09-21. The purchases were made at weighted average prices of $51.08 and $49.63 per unit, respectively. The total purchase amount was $503,550. Global Gp Llc directly owns 171,584 common units following the reported transactions. Global Gp Llc states the units were purchased to satisfy obligations under the Global Partners LP Long-Term Incentive Plan and disclaims any pecuniary interest in these securities.
